title: The Screenplay Registry v1 Registry-Index Record
description: JSON Schema for a single off-chain registry-index record. See /spec/v1/10-registry-index.md for the authoritative specification. This is an OFF-CHAIN discovery artifact, NOT a committedClaim field and NOT part of any v1 commitment surface. The script `contentHash` is deliberately absent and is forbidden at any depth (membership-oracle boundary).

claimHash.description: Primary key and join key. The same opaque commitment carried by the envelope. Recomputable by a script-holder; never the script fingerprint.

title.description: OPTIONAL public, searchable listing label chosen by the registrant. Self-published; not auto-extracted PII.

registeredAt.description: INFORMATIONAL only. Never used for priority or tie resolution — the truth is the .ots height against Bitcoin. An operator-supplied wall-clock label.

pubkey.description: The registrant's Ed25519 public key (Section 02 registrant block).

name.description: OPTIONAL chosen label (pen name / handle / real name — the registrant's choice). Blank by default.

proofRef.description: A snapshot-relative reference (filename) to the record's .ots proof. Resolved ONLY relative to the snapshot directory by the loader; absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, and symlinks are rejected at load time.

bitcoinBlock.description: INFORMATIONAL hint only. An OTS-CLAIMED height parsed from the .ots is NOT Bitcoin-final until an attestation verifier confirms header inclusion. Priority is resolved from the verified height, never from this hint.

EthereumAnchor.description: OPTIONAL secondary Ethereum-anchor coordinates (Section 09). Informational; NEVER a priority source.
